definitions.short: Kibroth-hat-Taavh , a place in the Desert
definitions.full: H6914. Qibroth Hattaavah הַתַּאֲוָה קִבְרוֺת proper name, of a location Μνήμαγα ( τῆς ) ἐπιθυμίας : a station in wilderness ( the graves of desire , compare Num 11:34 and תַּאֲוָה above); — 11:34-35 , הַתּ ׳קִבְרֹת 33:16-17 , Deut 9:22 .
definitions.rootNote: from the feminine plural of 6913 and 8378 with the article interposed; graves of the longing ;
